newsitem.title: MEXICO: ICA interested in Argentina deal - source.
newsitem.headline: ICA interested in Argentina deal - source.

text.p: Mexican construction firm ICA is holding talks over the possible acquisition of a 50 percent stake in the construction arm of Argentine conglomerate Sociedad Comercial del Plata, a company director said on Monday.
"The Comercial del Plata construction firm that interests us is called CPC. What I can say is that were in talks, and we would be partners," an ICA director said, who asked not to be named.
Comercial del Plata said on Friday it hoped to obtain a total of $330 million from the sale of its holdings in the oil, construction and energy industries.

The ICA director said the company hoped to settle the deal during the first half of July. Although the director did not give the amount, local press reports estimate the deal could be worth $30 million.
